mapper.select: select category_seq, parent_seq, name from tbl_category where category_seq = #{categorySeq} and enabled = 'Y'

select q.question_seq, q.category_seq, q.content, q.question_type, q.required, q.sort_order, o.option_seq, o.content as option_content, o.sort_order as option_sort_order from tbl_question q left join tbl_question_option o on o.question_seq = q.question_seq and o.enabled = 'Y' where q.category_seq = #{categorySeq} and q.enabled = 'Y' order by q.sort_order, q.question_seq, o.sort_order, o.option_seq
select address from tbl_member where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
mapper.insert:
select seq_request.nextval from dual
insert into tbl_request (request_seq, customer_seq, expert_seq, category_seq, address, wish_date, budget, content, status, quote_deadline) values (#{requestSeq}, #{customerSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{address}, to_date(#{wishDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{budget}, #{content}, 'OPEN', sysdate + 2)
insert into tbl_request_answer (answer_seq, request_seq, question_seq, option_seq, answer) values (seq_request_answer.nextval, #{requestSeq}, #{questionSeq}, #{optionSeq}, #{answer})
insert into tbl_request_file (file_seq, request_seq, org_filename, save_filename) values (seq_request_file.nextval, #{requestSeq}, #{orgFilename}, #{saveFilename})
